transport: in-memory synthetic fixture; real production Next application
checks: required fields show associated errors without sending a command
save disables the form while pending and resets only after confirmed response
conflict preserves typed values, blocks resubmit and reload restores server version
destructive dialog focuses cancel, traps keyboard focus, closes on Escape and restores trigger
production CSS keeps storage and modal within phone/tablet/desktop viewports
confirmed removal updates the list and leaves an enduring status message
access lock unmounts private form and portal content
